request.content: Build a course-grounded study deck. Use only the claims and source lines supplied below; do not add outside facts, examples, definitions or numbers. Keep every "> Source:" line verbatim on the slide it belongs to, directly below its claim. Draw an instructional diagram when a visual is described; do not add decorative or stock imagery. Put speaker notes in the notes lines, not on the slide itself. Do not leave placeholder text. Visuals to draw: Free-body diagram of a block on a slope with weight, normal and friction arrows.
slides_markdown:
# Forces on an Inclined Plane
> Notes: Open with the free-body diagram.

# Equilibrium on the Slope
- The downhill component of weight is mg sin(theta).
> Source: page 2
- The normal force balances mg cos(theta).
> Source: page 2
> Notes: Trace each arrow back to the object.

# Check by Substitution
- At equilibrium the net force along the plane is zero.
> Source: page 2
> Notes: Ask students to verify the result.
